content.summary: Shares of electronics manufacturing services provider Jabil (NYSE:JBL) jumped 3.5% in the morning session after an analyst reiterated a Strong Buy rating on the stock, coupled with the company's forecast for strong annual results. This statement appeared to boost investor confidence.

content.title: JBL Q4 Deep Dive: Data Center and AI Demand Drive Broad-Based Growth
content.summary: Electronics manufacturing services provider Jabil (NYSE:JBL) reported Q4 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 18.7% year on year to $8.31 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $7.75 billion at the midpoint, 2.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.85 per share was 4.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
